issue.title: Bug: bgp/test_bgp_session.py does not clean up changed config in all cases

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the bug

In bgp/test_bgp_session.py::test_bgp_session_interface_down, there is an assertion outside the try/finally which allows for test cleanup.

The assertion in question is here:
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/blob/master/tests/bgp/test_bgp_session.py#L225-L229

If this assertion fails, the peer interface is left in the disabled state.  This causes pretest errors for many (if not all) subsequent tests as not all BGP sessions are able to be established.

### Steps to Reproduce

Manually fail the assertion above, and veify that the peer is left in a dirty config state.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

The test should not leave test-specific config around.

resolution.title: sonic-mgmt: Fix test cleanup of intf config
resolution.description:
In bgp/test_bgp_session.py, move all assertions in verification of interface flap testing into the try/finally, so that config changes are undone after ALL failures and subsequent tests do not fail due to not all BGP sessions being established.

### Description of PR

Summary:
Fixes #22235

### Type of change

- [x] Bug fix
- [ ] Testbed and Framework(new/improvement)
- [ ] New Test case
    - [ ] Skipped for non-supported platforms
- [ ] Test case improvement

### Back port request
- [ ] 202205
- [ ] 202305
- [ ] 202311
- [ ] 202405
- [ ] 202411
- [x] 202505
- [x] 202511

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
Fixing this issue allows subsequent tests run after a failing instance of bgp/test_bgp_session.py to run and potentially pass, instead of failing due to pretest errors caused by bad cleanup.

#### How did you do it?
Move all assertions which may result in test failure inside a try/catch/finally, which includes configuration cleanup as a part of the finally clause.

#### How did you verify/test it?
Manual test run.
